plan.models: fixed historical models; training-fitted AUROC orientations fixed
plan.population: full frozen dictionary; reapply positive support >=10 in every draw, including originally ineligible units
plan.strata: original four-bin covariate cutpoints fixed; cell label counts recomputed on expanded patient copies
plan.null: shuffle expanded slice labels without replacement within each stratum; same permutations across models
plan.top10: recomputed with multiplicity; descending activation, original slice index, copy index ties
plan.interval: pointwise percentile 2.5/97.5, conditional on fitted models and original analysis choices
plan.aggregation: average SAE seeds within encoder, then equal-weight encoder average; no resampling encoder seeds
plan.scope: exploratory reused validation cohort; excludes model/selection uncertainty; finite inner Monte Carlo error remains
